[ORACLE] Debezium source connector parsing

Hi,
Hope this message finds you well.
This time, I'm writing because there is an intriguing issue.
So, it's important to give some context first. We are using those two source connectors (online_catalog (LOBs) + hybrid (No LOBs) to deal with DDL mixing). After the initial snapshot, everything goes right, the streaming is working as supposed to (we tested 2k rows).
At the moment we run the upgrade script, which contains DML mixed with DDL, something strange happens. The source connector (hybrid) fails to parse the data, and it propagate to kafka the data wrong.
For example, there is this table which has different columns (Col1,...,Coln). In the initial streaming the connector inserts the data to kafka corretly. After running the script in source db, it inserts the data (in kafka) from column 2 to column 1 (PK), which leads to schema error even after propagation schema alteration to sink db.
The payloads below represent what I'm trying to explain above.
In the first message, which is wrong, it skips the data from the first column. In the second, it is well processed.

evidence.quote: This does tie back to DBZ-7835 but in a slightly different way due to the column being invisible/generated. Unfortunately for now, this will require a code change ... I have logged DBZ-8597

notes: Column values shift by one after DDL when the table has an invisible generated column that LogMiner omits from redo SQL. Debezium's column-position mapping in the LogMiner DML parser is the defect.
